title: Three layers, one poster.
intro: A JavaScript recipe places words and artwork in a single styled scene.

stages.title: Layout
stages.caption: CSS defines the space for the headline, leaf and food illustrations.

stages.title: Lettering
stages.caption: The fixture supplies the headline and captions as editable text.

stages.title: Artwork
stages.caption: Transparent cutouts let the lettering and layout show through.

stages.title: Assembled poster
stages.caption: All three share one set of coordinates.

exports.name: Satori
exports.path: Builds an SVG. resvg turns it into a PNG.

exports.name: Chromium
exports.path: Playwright captures the HTML layout as a PNG.
